mainEntity.name: How much does stucco remediation cost in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of stucco remediation in Pasadena varies widely depending on several factors, including the square footage of the affected area, the severity of water damage, the type of stucco system chosen for replacement, and accessibility to the building. Minor repairs could range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars, while extensive whole-house remediation can cost tens of thousands. Obtaining multiple detailed quotes from local contractors is essential for an accurate estimate.
